overview.description: The Guggenheim Enhanced Equity Income ETF (GEEQ) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in large cap equity. The fund is an actively managed ETF that invests primarily in US large-cap stocks with high dividend yields or free cash flow yields while using a call option overlay to generate additional income. The fund seeks current income while maintaining prospects for capital appreciation. GEEQ was launched on Aug 20, 2026 and is issued by Guggenheim.
